summary: Tekirdağ province records no province-specific statute, enforcement action, incident or institution concerning transgender visitors, and no region-specific signal was identified in the sources. The province stands under the national framework of Turkey, carried on the parent record, including Law No. 2911 on public assemblies, which binds authorities in Tekirdağ as it does across the country.
tangentialFactors: The documented enforcement in the source inventory was recorded in other provinces, not in Tekirdağ. Amnesty International's Türkiye country report (Report 2025/26) records blanket bans issued in June 2025 against the LGBTI and Trans pride marches in Istanbul, unlawful force against peaceful protesters, over 90 arbitrary detentions, three activists remanded on 29 June 2025 and released on 8 August pending trial, and prosecutions of 92 people for participating in pride marches still running at year's end. In December 2025 an İzmir court ordered the dissolution of the Young LGBTI+ Association over 'obscene' images said to be incompatible with society's moral values and capable of encouraging LGBTI identities. No comparable ban, prosecution or dissolution has been recorded in Tekirdağ.
localsOnly: No resident-facing facts specific to Tekirdağ were identified. The province's own police, courts and public institutions are not documented in the sources in relation to LGBTI or transgender residents, and no province-level detention, prosecution or administrative practice is recorded.
outOfScopeNotes: Whether Law No. 2911 has been invoked to ban or prosecute an assembly in Tekirdağ is unresolved: the sources document its use in Istanbul and İzmir only, and contain no Tekirdağ-level data on permits, refusals or charges. Whether any LGBTI or transgender resident of Tekirdağ has faced the assembly, association-dissolution or identity-check practices recorded elsewhere in Turkey is likewise not sourced at province level. The national claims carried on the parent record are not corroborated by any Tekirdağ-specific material.
